name: Elisaveta Stein
source:
The youngest daughter of the founder of Pogranichnoye and her official successor.

Lisa has always been shy, quiet, and empathetic. She feels other people’s emotions so deeply that they drown out her own. Due to her poor health, she rarely leaves the house, spending her days immersed in scientific literature or lost in dreams, where she prefers to escape from reality.
